title: Jewelled Korean Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious Korean-inspired rice bowl dish loaded with jewelled rice, tender beef, and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and sauté the diced carrots until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Korean chili flakes and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of jewelled rice in each bowl, followed by the beef and vegetable mixture.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and sliced scallions.
